title: Zamiana Prystawek w Maszynie Bezpieczeństwo
reason: Demonstrates the operation and safety features of a pruning machine.

tasks.task: Describe the quick couplings and safety mechanisms shown in the machine.

subtasks.text: Observe the two quick couplings and how they work.
Notice the two counter screws and how they are used.
Observe the hydraulic system and the three clutches.
Notice the safety feature that secures the machine with the control panel.

tasks.task: Explain the operation and handling of the machine.

subtasks.text: Describe how the machine works by pushing back the chain when necessary.
Observe the safety feature that prevents the machine from moving when there's an obstruction.
Note the safety brake feature and how it allows the machine to back up.

tasks.task: Discuss the operator platform and its functionality.

subtasks.text: Observe the platform for the operator and its mobility.
Notice that the operator platform moves to adapt to uneven ground.
